app.commerce-reconcile.title: Commerce Reconcile
app.commerce-reconcile.adminApi.disabled: The Shopify Admin API is not configured. Reconciliation cannot run until it is set up in Commerce settings.
app.commerce-reconcile.adminApi.required: Configure the Shopify Admin API first.
app.commerce-reconcile.reconcile.runMsg: Run a product reconciliation pass now? It detects drift and refreshes the CMS mirror from Shopify (nothing is written to Shopify).
app.commerce-reconcile.reconcile.runMsgI: Run a full inventory audit now? It re-checks every inventory item against Shopify through a Bulk operation and refreshes the CMS mirror (nothing is written to Shopify).
app.commerce-reconcile.reconcile.started: Inventory audit job enqueued. It appears in the history once it finishes.
app.commerce-reconcile.reconcile.already: An inventory audit is already running.
app.commerce-reconcile.history.empty: No runs in the selected period.
